frameworks.title: Word order: SOV
frameworks.body: Hindi puts the verb last, like Urdu. 'I water drink' (मैं पानी पीता हूँ). The grammar is nearly identical to Urdu.

frameworks.title: Gender + verb agreement
frameworks.body: Verbs change based on the gender of the subject. लड़का खाता है (boy eats) vs लड़की खाती है (girl eats).

frameworks.title: Devanagari is phonetic
frameworks.body: Each letter = one sound. No silent letters, no spelling chaos. Once you know the script, you can pronounce ANY Hindi word.
